body:
## Motivation

The ordinary TP=1 diffusion loading path paid avoidable device-transfer and tensor-copy costs, especially when the DiT was configured to remain on CPU. A more aggressive direct-to-GPU load can further reduce cold-start time for some models, but substantially increases transient GPU memory and is not universally faster.

## Changes

- Load an unquantized CPU-offloaded DiT directly on CPU instead of staging its checkpoint tensors and materialized weights through GPU.
- Let eligible TP=1 CPU parameters adopt shape/dtype-compatible checkpoint storage, avoiding a second allocation and copy.
- Add `--direct-gpu-weight-loading`, disabled by default, for CUDA, unquantized, GPU-resident, TP=1, non-FSDP DiTs. It keeps the complete mapped checkpoint state dict on GPU while parameters are materialized.
- Reject incompatible direct-loading combinations explicitly.
- Document that direct-GPU startup impact is model-dependent and requires deployment-specific benchmarking.

The default path does not increase peak GPU memory. Quantized, FSDP, TP>1, and custom weight-loader paths retain their existing behavior unless they satisfy the narrowly checked CPU-storage adoption conditions.

## B200 Results

Cached checkpoints, `--warmup-mode off`, one GPU.

### Default low-memory optimization with CPU-offloaded DiT

| Model | Main | Optimized | Delta | Peak GPU |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Z-Image-Turbo | 40.07 s | 32.71 s | -18.4% | 7658 -> 7658 MiB |
| Qwen-Image | 62.78 s | 34.67 s | -44.8% | 9362 -> 9362 MiB |
| Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B | 38.74 s | 37.84 s | -2.3% | 11602 -> 11602 MiB |

### Opt-in direct GPU loading

| Model | Default | Direct GPU | Delta | Peak GPU |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Z-Image-Turbo | 34.86 s | 31.91 s | -8.5% | 19662 -> 32528 MiB |
| Qwen-Image | 40.97 s | 38.39 s | -6.3% | 48318 -> 84458 MiB |
| Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B | 39.57 s | 39.72 s | +0.4% | 14478 -> 18446 MiB |

The opt-in path is useful only when the measured cold-start gain justifies the extra memory. It remains disabled by default.

## Correctness And Validation

- Identical seed and parameters produced byte-identical Z-Image and Qwen-Image PNGs and a byte-identical Wan MP4 on the optimized default path.
- Default and direct-GPU Z-Image generation produced byte-identical PNGs.
- B200 unit suites: `175 passed`, `20 subtests passed`.
- Changed-file pre-commit suite passed after merging the latest `main`.
